# Devin — Practical iOS shipping assets

> A small store of field-tested iOS engineering kits: a 60-check performance audit, an SPM modularization starter kit, and a 40-point App Store release checklist. Built from 13 years of production iOS work. One-time purchase. Single item → Buy now on Gumroad (secure checkout, instant download). Multiple items or invoice needed → Email order; we reply within 24 hours with an invoice (PayPal or bank transfer).

Updated: 2026-10-25
Canonical: https://hhfa008.github.io/store/
Contact: superapp.devin@gmail.com

## Site structure

- [Home](https://hhfa008.github.io/store/): What the four kits cover, who they are for, the measure → structure → submit flow, delivery and support terms, and a 45-second overview video.
- [Kit details](https://hhfa008.github.io/store/product.html): Shared detail template that renders one kit by its `id` query parameter, including contents, format, price, and fit.
- [iOS Performance Audit Checklist](https://hhfa008.github.io/store/product.html?id=performance-audit): 60 checks across cold launch, first-frame rendering, memory growth, scrolling, and app size, with a measurement note and target for each. $1 (reg. $39), PDF + Markdown.
- [SPM Modularization Starter Kit](https://hhfa008.github.io/store/product.html?id=spm-starter-kit): Buildable four-target Swift package (App, Feature, Core, DesignSystem) with a six-step migration playbook, layering docs, and a CI gate for dependency direction. $1 (reg. $59), Swift package + Markdown guide.
- [App Store Release Checklist](https://hhfa008.github.io/store/product.html?id=release-checklist): A 40-point pass from build settings to review notes, with a rejection-risk note on every check and a Release record for the ship decision. $1 (reg. $19), PDF + Markdown.
- [iOS Design Starter Kit](https://hhfa008.github.io/store/product.html?id=ios-design-starter): 160 icons with a Swift enum, four checked light/dark palettes, and sample fixtures with Codable models. $1 (reg. $29), Swift package + design assets.
- [Free sample](https://hhfa008.github.io/store/free-sample.html): Five complete checks, one from each section of the performance audit — launch, memory, scrolling, package size, and stability — with the exact test procedure and pass criteria.
- [Checkout](https://hhfa008.github.io/store/checkout.html): Order review page before payment; single items go to Gumroad checkout, multi-item orders are emailed for an invoice.

## Products

- iOS Performance Audit Checklist — $1 (reg. $39) — find the launch, memory, scrolling, and package-size problems users feel first.
- SPM Modularization Starter Kit — $1 (reg. $59) — turn one app target into a modular Swift package without slowing the team down.
- App Store Release Checklist — $1 (reg. $19) — a calm, 40-point pass through everything App Review checks before Submit.
- iOS Design Starter Kit — $1 (reg. $29) — 160 icons, four checked palettes, and sample fixtures with Codable models.
